{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=January 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2010–11 |team=Saint Mary's Gaels |image=Saint Mary's College Gaels logo.svg |image_size=200px |conference=West Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=WCC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=25–9 |conf_record=11–3 |head_coach=[[Randy Bennett]] |asst_coach1=[[Rick Croy]] |asst_coach2=[[Adam Caporn]] |asst_coach3=[[Eran Ganot]] |stadium=[[McKeon Pavilion]] |champion = WCC regular season co-champions |bowl= NIT |bowl_result= First Round }} {{2010-11 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2010–11 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team''' represented [[Saint Mary's College of California]] in the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11]] [[college basketball]] season. This was head coach [[Randy Bennett]]'s tenth season at Saint Mary's. The Gaels competed in the [[West Coast Conference]] and played their home games at the [[McKeon Pavilion]]. They finished the season 25–9, 11–3 in WCC play to tie with [[2010–11 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] for the regular season conference title. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2011 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament]] before losing to Gonzaga. As a regular season champion who failed to win their conference tournament, the Gaels earned an automatic bid in the [[2011 National Invitation Tournament]] where they were upset in the first round by [[2010–11 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]]. ==Roster== Source{{Cite web|url=http://www.smcgaels.com/SportSelect.dbml?&DB_OEM_ID=21400&SPID=12536&SPSID=101618|title=SMC California Athletics -
